title: Postcard up up
html_source:
Chapter 8 tells of Mr. Breen receiving a mysterious card with the message U.P. on it and his desire to take legal action against the joke for 10,000 pounds.

“–Read that, she said. He got it this morning.
–What is it? Mr Bloom asked, taking the card. U.P.?
–U.P.: up, she said. Someone taking a rise out of him. It’s a great shame for them whoever he is.”
